resolved_conflicts.explanation: The survey table lists the Minnesota Forest Service as the original agency and a private party as current owner. NHLR names William Multer as the private landowner. The story uses both: a former state forestry site, now privately owned.
The brief record says access is unknown. The survey compilation says the site is not accessible to the public, and NHLR says it is privately owned, so the record is set to private.

sources.title: Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers, Koochiching County (survey compilation)

notes_for_editor: The 1927 build date is supported by NHLR and by the survey table, but both rest on the same survey tradition and the table text is garbled in places. The 1967 survey note calls the cab bird-cage type and also octagonal; the story reports both. The Central US Lookouts listing and the blog page were not usable for detail (blog returned 404). The brief's Central US coordinates (lon -93.80326) disagree with NHLR and FFLOS (lon about -93.7795); the record's own coordinates match NHLR. The brief's 'Built' value comes from NHLR. No staffing, fire or ownership-transfer dates were found. A WebSearch summary described a station on MN 11 and County Road 32 at the tower's location, but that was not read from a page, so it is not used. The NHLR photo credit (Tom Kremer) has no image URL, so no photo is recorded.
